name: Chesnaught
description: Chesnaught, the Spiny Armor Pokémon, and the evolved form of Quilladin. A Grass and Fighting type.
pokedex_entries: Its Tackle is forceful enough to flip a 50-ton tank. It shields its allies from danger with its own body.
When it takes a defensive posture with its fists guarding its face, it could withstand a bomb blast.
